question: who awarded lydie hakizimana the francophone woman of the year award
answer: The Mayor of Paris, Anne Hidalgo, during the 41st Congress of Francophone Mayors in Kigali, Rwanda.
evidence: Ms. Lydie Hakizimana received the Award from the Mayor of Paris, Anne Hidalgo, during the 41st Congress of Francophone Mayors organised by the International Association of Francophone Mayors (AIMF) in Kigali, Rwanda
